digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and timezone handling
propositions: Enable Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families in pyproject.toml after resolving all current violations in src/rebar and tests

Timestamp validation semantics must use datetime.timezone.utc for both epoch-second conversion (fromtimestamp with tz parameter) and timezone-less persisted strings (strptime with explicit UTC assignment)
Security-pin cadence logic must obtain an aware current instant with explicit tz argument, convert to host timezone, and extract local calendar date while passing DTZ005 compliance
Behavioral tests must prove UTC timestamp clustering is timezone-invariant under at least two distinct TZ environment values on platforms supporting time.tzset()
Production code in src/rebar must not use the literal datetime.UTC token; all UTC construction must use datetime.timezone.utc for py310 compatibility
